name: mauzcode-desktop
description: Secure desktop client for an existing MauzCode server
author: MauzCode contributors

scripts.check: bun build main.cjs preload.cjs remote-preload.cjs renderer.js --target=node --external electron --external electron-updater --outdir .check
scripts.build:win: bun run prefetch:win && electron-builder --config tools/builder.cjs --win nsis --x64 --publish never
